status: editorial briefs, not published content or traffic forecasts
rule: A brief is a backlog option, never a ranking quota. Publish only after a founder fact sheet supplies original observations, verified facts, rights, and a useful buyer decision. AI may organize and edit; founder verifies every claim.

cadence.launch: Target three short, useful guides already tied to launch decisions; if evidence is missing, ship the commercial core and defer a guide rather than inventing facts.
cadence.days_1_30: Improve offer answers from real buyer questions; no additional blog post quota.
cadence.days_31_60: Default one new evidence-led guide or properly labeled project case, chosen from actual inquiry patterns; record all-in hours.
cadence.days_61_90: Default one further guide or case if capacity and evidence allow; default 0 municipality pages.
cadence.days_91_180: Set cadence from observed asset hours, buyer demand and sales assistance after a monthly review; one useful asset/month is a planning baseline only, and pause when client delivery or weak evidence takes priority.
cadence.stretch_new_assets_first_90_days: Four to six additional after launch, seven to nine total including the three launch guides, only if the first two new assets each take no more than 3-4 all-in founder hours including source research, fact review, rights review, writing, design, links, accessibility and QA; each has unique firsthand proof and real query/buyer need; and the client calendar preserves contracted delivery and the 60-hour weekly ceiling. This is an optional observed-capacity gate, never an article or ranking target.
cadence.no_guarantee: No post count, cadence, publication date, ranking, indexing, lead, or AI citation guarantee.
